sections.name: validatedExamples
sections.title: Choosing well-documented source examples
sections.what: Returns up to 12 recorded evidence quotes for the given projects. Each one is tied to a saved web page capture that has an image and whose text still matches the stored quote. Projects with more separate web sites come first.
sections.why: The code comment says a quote is never treated as matched just because it has a URL, so only proven matches are returned.
sections.watch_out: The database query keeps only the first 40 rows in evidence ID order before the ranking runs, so strong examples can be dropped silently.
